name: CGB
recent: Central Global Berhad 近期出现多项股权与人事变动：委任 Ong Shiow Yee 为首席财务官，并有多名董事及主要股东在闭门交易期进行股份买卖。此外，公司委任 Ismail bin Mamat 为独立非执行董事及薪酬委员会主席。
notable: 委任 Ong Shiow Yee 为首席财务官。
委任 Ismail bin Mamat 为独立非执行董事及薪酬委员会主席。
集团执行董事 Lee Chee Vui 在闭门交易期进行股份买卖。
risks: 主要股东 Soo Yu Chai 减持 488 万股。
earnings: 2025年6月30日止季度营收为 9817.6 万令吉，环比增长 27.3%；净利为 301.9 万令吉，环比下降 22.4%；净利率从 5.0% 降至 3.1%。

recent_en: Central Global Berhad has seen several equity and personnel changes recently: Ong Shiow Yee was appointed as CFO, and several directors and substantial shareholders traded shares during the closed period. The company also appointed Ismail bin Mamat as Independent Non-Executive Director and Chairman of the Remuneration Committee.
notable_en: Appointed Ong Shiow Yee as Chief Financial Officer.
Appointed Ismail bin Mamat as Independent Non-Executive Director and Chairman of the Remuneration Committee.
Group Executive Director Lee Chee Vui traded shares during the closed period, with a net disposal of approximately 4.63 million shares.
risks_en: Group Executive Director Lee Chee Vui made a net disposal of approximately 4.63 million shares during the closed period.
Substantial shareholder Soo Yu Chai disposed of 4.88 million shares.
Group Financial Controller Ng Jia Wei disposed of 1.5 million shares during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2025, revenue was MYR 98.176 million, up 27.3% QoQ; net income was MYR 3.019 million, down 22.4% QoQ; net margin fell from 5.0% to 3.1%.
